name: Persist OpenCode data
description: Ensures the remote user's OpenCode data (~/.local/share/opencode) and config (~/.config/opencode) directories exist with correct ownership before they are mounted as persistent named volumes, so OpenCode's sessions, state, and configuration survive container rebuilds. Pair with matching 'mounts' entries in devcontainer.json -- this feature only prepares the directories, it does not declare the mounts itself.
